gloss: to be acquired; to become second nature

definitions.gloss: to be acquired; to sink in; to become second nature (a skill, habit, knowledge)
definitions.explanation: For a skill, habit, or piece of knowledge to become one's own, so that it stays with one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{身|み}につく。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{続|つづ}ければ、⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{身|み}につく。
examples.english: If you keep it up every day, the habit of getting up early will stick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{込|こ}んだ→詰め込む：04242_tsumekomu⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{身|み}につかない。
examples.english: Knowledge crammed for an exam rarely sinks in.

notes:
With {身|み}につく the skill or habit is the subject; with ⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧ the learner is. Also written ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{身|み}につく: knowledge sinks in
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{身|み}につく: a habit takes hold
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{身|み}につく: one's ability grows
- {身|み}につかない: does not stick, is not really learned

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: intransitive
- Pair: ⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧ (transitive, to acquire)

forms.negative: {身|み}についていませんでした
